title: Opening a published event lists its live round
preconditions: Session: the BUYER (owner of the sandbox). The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single price round {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids.
steps: 2. The rounds list holds the open price round; the current round is that round.
expectedResult: HTTP 200; the event's rounds exclude void/cancelled ones and are ordered by stage number (app/models/event_group.rb:62; app/models/trade_request.rb:256-259); current_active_stage is the running round (app/serializers/event_group/show_serializer.rb:201; app/models/event_group.rb current_active_stage).
rationale: The console's round tabs and the landing round come from this read.
